name: QuranApp
tagline: Ad-free Quran reading, translation and recitation
description:
QuranApp puts a translation you can read next to the Arabic — more than 45 translations across 20-odd languages, plus tafsir commentaries when you want a fuller explanation. Read verse by verse or in a mushaf page layout, in whichever Arabic script suits you.

Recitations from many reciters play with the text scrolling along, at the speed you choose, and you can repeat a verse or a range while memorising. Bookmark verses with your own notes, search the whole text, and set a verse of the day reminder.

There are no ads, no purchases, no tracking and no account to make. Translations, tafsir and recitations all work offline once you have downloaded them.
